public_api.name: run_command
public_api.description: Execute a shell command. Returns (stdout, stderr, returncode).

public_api.name: run_command_safe
public_api.description: Safe command execution for agent tools. Limits output length and catches errors.

public_api.name: run_command_detached
public_api.description:
Start command in background; append stdout/stderr to каталог данных проекта (``.lorne`` / legacy ``.tca``) / ``<log_name>``.

Use for long-running dev servers (``npm run dev``) so the agent is not blocked.
